title: Static Limbless Tadpole
description: One original stylised limbless amphibian-larva-inspired appearance. A broad blunt rounded head-body continues directly into one long gently sideways-bent tapering muscular tail, with a complete finite-thickness upper and lower tail-fin envelope in the very same closed shared-vertex surface. Two small dark eyes are visibly inset into the broad head. Newly authored whole axial sections, belly, taper, curvature and fin silhouette; no adult frog head or body is copied, shrunk or stripped of limbs, and no old octopus arm, fish-skeleton tail or fishing-float profile is reused. One complete body/fin mesh plus two small closed eye meshes, three opaque matte PBR materials. One prop and zero scenes, not multiple growth stages or a whole life cycle. Metres, native Z up, presentation front -Y and head toward -X, complete horizontal bounds-centred grounded belly display. Static artistic exterior only, no real species, life-size or developmental-stage accuracy, internal anatomy, biological transparency, swimming, growth, animation, breathing, buoyancy, welfare or ecological performance claim.
